criterion 1.description: States the Enterprise Value as £10,000,000 (acceptable value is £10,000,000)
criterion 1.justification: The Prompt articulates the EV is £10,000,000

criterion 2.description: Calculates excess cash as £15,000 (acceptable value is £15,000)
criterion 2.sources: Mercor - EV to Equity Bridge - Test Version (V2)
criterion 2.justification: From the 'Mercor - EV to Equity Bridge - Test Version' file, deduct the minimum cash requirement of £5,000 from the cash at Bank of £20,000 at Mar-25 to calculate Excess Cash of £15,000

criterion 3.description: Calculates Debt/Debt-like items as £7,000 (acceptable value is £7,000)
criterion 3.sources: Mercor - EV to Equity Bridge - Test Version (V2)
criterion 3.justification: From the 'Mercor - EV to Equity Bridge - Test Version' file, extract the £7,000 of corporation tax at Mar-25. Taxes payable are considered debt-like items for an EV to Equity Bridge while trade creditors and accruals are captured within the net working capital adjustment and should not be double‑counted.

criterion 4.description: Calculates the net working capital adjustment at Mar-25 of £1,667 (acceptable range between £1,650 and £1,684)
criterion 4.sources: Mercor - EV to Equity Bridge - Test Version (V2)
criterion 4.justification: Add: trade debtors (£35,000), other debtors (£10,000), accrued income (£3,000), prepayments (£1,000) and subtract trade creditors (£26,000) and accruals (£5,000) to arrive at £18,000 actual net working capital at Mar-25 Do this for all months, and then take a simple average of each month's net working capital to get £16,333 average net working capital for the last 12 months Subtract the average net working capital position at Mar-25 from the actual net working capital position at Mar-25 to equal £1,667

criterion 5.description: Calculate the Equity value for the company at Mar-25 of £10,009,667 (acceptable range £10,009,650 to £10,009,684)
criterion 5.justification: Add the excess cash of approximately £15,000 to the Enterprise value of £10,000,000, deduct £7,000 due to tax being a debt-like item and add the net working capital adjustment of £1,667 to achieve an Equity Value of £10,009,667
